earnings.title: Marriott International Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Third quarter reported diluted EPS totaled $3.04 and Adjusted diluted EPS totaled $3.02
Third quarter reported net income totaled $794 million and Adjusted net income totaled $790 million
Ma rriott’s reported operating income totaled $1,274 million in the 2026 third quarter, compared to 2025 third quarter reported operating income of $1,180 million.
The company repurchased 3.5 million shares of common stock for $1.3 billion in the 2026 third quarter .
Year-to-date through October 28, the company has returned approximately $4.0 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases
outlook: For full year 2026, given our strong third quarter performance and expectations for continued healthy demand, we are raising our global RevPAR outlook and now expect growth of 4.5 to 5 percent.

items.heading: Disagreements with hotel owners and other counterparties could materially impact our business, operations, financial results, and growth.

The effects of, or our failure to comply with, applicable laws, regulations, and government policies may disrupt our business, lower our revenues, increase our costs, reduce our profits, limit our growth, or damage our reputation.
If our brands, goodwill, or other intangible assets become impaired, we may be required to record significant non-cash charges to earnings.
Our Loyalty Program plays a significant role in our business, and unfavorable developments affecting the program could adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Additional cybersecurity incidents could have adverse effects on our business.
Delaware law and our governing corporate documents contain, and our Board of Directors could implement, anti-takeover provisions that could deter takeover attempts.
